world.title: A Multi Utility Dataset of Water and Energy Consumption from Spanish Residential Households
world.description: This paper introduces a household-level multi-utility dataset capturing one year of telemetry at a 7-minute sampling interval from 10 Spanish homes. Signals include cold and hot water volumes, electricity use, and thermal/HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) measurements, complemented by an outdoor temperature probe. In addition to the household measurements, the dataset includes a complementary set of labelled lab-generated events recorded at a 1-minute sampling interval. The laboratory data reproduces common residential end-uses like showers (with varying durations and patterns), water closet (WC) flushes, and washing-machine programs aligned to the sensor streams. This resource enables exploration in anomaly detection, predictive modelling, disaggregation studies, activity recognition, and analysis of water-energy coupling.
